description: Documentation for the `Dialog` class in Playwright, including class overview, usage examples in multiple languages (JavaScript, Java, Python, C#), and method descriptions.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a browser dialog, such as alert, confirm, prompt, or beforeunload, that is dispatched by a Page.

methods.name: Dialog.accept
methods.description: Accepts the dialog, optionally providing prompt text if the dialog is a prompt.

methods.name: Dialog.message
methods.description: Returns the message displayed in the dialog.

methods.name: Dialog.page
methods.description: Returns the page that initiated the dialog, if available.

methods.name: Dialog.type
methods.description: Returns the type of dialog: alert, confirm, prompt, or beforeunload.
